item.title: KNOW a KAOS DJ: DJ Mason, Call Me Up — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: Meet Mason: Greener, student staffer, and DJ extraordinaire. Host of “Call Me Up”, a show where musicians record their sets over a phone call, and “Tape Show!”, a cassette appreciation hour.

item.title: KAOS CD Sale this Tuesday, Nov 4th! — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: Come to the KAOS CD Sale! This Tuesday Nov. 4th from 10am-5pm in CAB 301. On the third floor of the CAB building on The Evergreen State College campus. CDs are 25 cents each or 5/$1. Your contributions help support local community radio!

item.title: Afrok on KAOS Live - November 12th! — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: Join KAOS Live for a performance from local emcee Afrok on Wednesday November 12th at 8pm!

item.title: Give to KAOS and Help Support Local Community Radio — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: The Give Local South Puget Sound Campaign is live! They are raising money for KAOS, the South Sound’s community freeform radio station. Support diverse, local, and underrepresented voices today.

item.title: Arrington de Dionyso live on KAOS - 11/16 on KAOS Live — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: Please join us for a live performance from KAOS alumni and Olympia music legend ARRINGTON DE DIONYSO this Wednesday, November 26th at 8pm!

item.title: KNOW a KAOS DJ: K.Punk, The Sound — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: We chatted with the host of “The Sound” (Thursdays 8-10pm). Read the interview and get to know K.Punk, a longtime KAOSian and Evergreen alum who brings local artists in-studio and on-air!

item.title: Best of 2025 - KAOS DJs Pick Their Favorites — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: See the best songs, albums and more from 2025 from KAOS DJs!

item.title: Rejoice: Our CD Sale is Wednesday, Feb 25th — KAOS 89.3FM Olympia
item.description: The next KAOS 89.3FM CD Sale is Wednesday, February 25th, from 11am-3pm in The Porter Lounge, CAB 306 at The Evergreen State College.

item.description: Seattle avant mosscore band Mt. Fog perform live on KAOS This Wednesday, March 25th at 8pm PST Only on KAOS Live, with your hosts Miss Melissa and DJ Richard Mt. Fog have a new album out - EVERY STONE IS GREEN, and it is available for purchase online and at selected local Washington record stores
